Name: idaida's Aviary Coop (for CP and AT)
Author: idaida
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][url=https://www.patreon.com/idaida][img]https://i.imgur.com/A5ZwJYT.png[/img][/url]
This mod replaces the vanilla coop with the new and aviary sprites. The colors should work well with vanilla and world recolors. [/color]
[color=#8e7cc3]The inside tiles are also replaced, to look cleaner and work better with an aviary aesthetic. [/color]


[color=#8e7cc3]All the textures in this mod are drawn by me or repurposed vanilla sprites that are recolored by me.[/color]


[color=#8e7cc3]I can only do very basic coding, so some elements of the mod are a little basic- the light on the aviary always appears to be on. There is no seasonal or AT version atm. 

[b]Thank you to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193812592-kungfauxhustle/][color=#8e7cc3]kungfauxhustle[/color][/url] for making the AT conversion.[/b][/color]
